Wayback_Machine.summary: The Wayback Machine is the Internet Archive's collection of saved web pages. It holds more than a trillion captures made since 1996, each one a copy of a page as it stood at a recorded moment, and lets a reader open any of them by URL and date. The item Snapshot of northstar.example (2026) is an example of a single capture.

Snapshot_of_northstar.example_(2026).title: Snapshot of northstar.example (2026)
Snapshot_of_northstar.example_(2026).summary: This item is a Wayback Machine capture of the home page of northstar.example, made on 4 February 2026 at 09:14 UTC. The capture is recorded here as an item because it was submitted through Save Page Now with a note, and notes are kept with the item rather than the capture.

sections.heading: Submitter's note
sections.body: Saved before the redesign announced for the following week. The page carries the original product description and the pricing table that was later changed. Kept for reference; nothing on the page is unusual.

sections.heading: What the capture holds
sections.body: The HTML of the home page and the stylesheet it referenced. Images were fetched and stored. A script that loaded the pricing table from a separate endpoint was not executed, so the table appears as it was in the page source.

search_entries.title: Snapshot of northstar.example, 4 February 2026 — Internet Archive
search_entries.snippet: A Wayback Machine capture of the northstar.example home page, saved before its redesign, with the submitter's note.
